blocks.text: Reproduction is the ability of an organism to produce new offspring of its own type. The reproductive systems produce reproductive cells (gametes) and prepare them for fertilization. The male system also delivers the gametes to the female system, and the female system nourishes the fertilized egg and provides an environment for it to develop into a baby.

blocks.title: How the reproductive system is different
blocks.text: The reproductive system differs from the other organ systems in two ways: it is quite different in males and females, while the others are almost the same; and it does not work until puberty, while the others work from birth or soon after.

blocks.prompt: Name two jobs that only the female reproductive system does.
blocks.explanation: It nourishes the fertilized egg and provides the environment in which it develops into a baby.

items: Reproductive systems make and prepare gametes; the male delivers them; the female nourishes and houses the developing baby.
